study_scope: matched macOS helper process policy/identity, keychain prompting and prior teardown reading; no source shipment
restore: For each acquired entry download url to response.path, verify response SHA-256, decode encoding to artifact.path and verify artifact SHA-256. Never execute or build these study snapshots.
failed_lookup_note: 404 entries are unsuccessful source-path guesses, not evidence of absent behavior; correct acquired files govern this report.
restore_command:
python3 - <<'PYRESTORE'
import json, pathlib, urllib.request, hashlib, base64
manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path('papers/native-matched-source-manifest.json').read_text())
for entry in manifest['entries']:
    if entry['status'] != 'acquired': continue
    wire=urllib.request.urlopen(entry['url'], timeout=60).read()
    assert hashlib.sha256(wire).hexdigest() == entry['response']['sha256'], entry['url']
    decoded=base64.b64decode(wire) if entry['encoding']=='base64' else wire
    assert hashlib.sha256(decoded).hexdigest() == entry['artifact']['sha256'], entry['url']
    for kind,data in [('response',wire),('artifact',decoded)]:
        dest=pathlib.Path(entry[kind]['path']); dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); dest.write_bytes(data)
PYRESTORE
